mapper.sql: id, payment_no, bill_id, bill_no, owner_id, owner_name, fee_name, amount, pay_method, pay_time, operator, remark

where.if: AND (payment_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR bill_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR owner_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR fee_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fee_payment (payment_no, bill_id, bill_no, owner_id, owner_name, fee_name, amount, pay_method, pay_time, operator, remark) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{billId}, #{billNo}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerName}, #{feeName}, IFNULL(#{amount}, 0), IFNULL(#{payMethod}, 'WECHAT'), IFNULL(#{payTime}, NOW()), #{operator}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m') AS name, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS value FROM fee_payment GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY name ASC
SELECT pay_method AS name, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS value FROM fee_payment GROUP BY pay_method ORDER BY amount DESC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM fee_payment WHERE DATE(pay_time) = CURDATE()
